description: This file defines an API route for exporting tasks associated with a project to CSV format using FastAPI. It includes dependencies, project validation, task filtering, and CSV serialization, and handles HTTP responses with appropriate headers.

methods.name: export_tasks_csv( projectId: int = Query(..., description="Project ID to export"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to export project tasks as a CSV file, validating project ownership, filtering tasks, converting to CSV, and returning as an HTTP response with appropriate headers.
